global: This is a bowl of spicy ramen with a rich, reddish broth. Topped with chashu pork, nori, and chopped green onions, it sits in a white bowl with a black rim, under warm lighting on a wooden table.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections.
regions.bowl: White enamel bowl with black rim, smooth surface, slightly glossy finish, and minor speckles visible.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is rich, reddish-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles, green onions, and sesame seeds.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and curved, elongated shape.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark, glossy, rectangular, and speckled with white sesame seeds on its surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice has light pinkish-white color, tender texture, irregular shape, and two green onion garnishes on its surface.
